newsitem.title: CROATIA: World Bank approves $102 mln loan to Croatia.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves $102 mln loan to Croatia.

text.p: The World Bank has approved a $102 million loan to Croatia to rebuild roads and railways and remove land mines leftover after the war with minority Serbs ended, state news agency HINA said on Friday.

It quoted a statement by the Croatian embassy in Washington as saying the reconstruction project would include the southern Adriatic port of Ploce which is key for funneling goods into the landlocked neighbouring Bosnia.
The loan is to be signed next week in Washington, HINA said but it did not mention any terms. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
